## The decrease multiplier {#fm1-decrease-factor .fm-slide }

::: {.takeaway}
$$\text{New amount}=\text{Original}\times\left(1-\frac{p}{100}\right)$$
:::

An 8% decrease leaves **92% of the original**.

$$100\%-8\%=92\%\qquad\longleftrightarrow\qquad0.92$$

::: notes
Booklet §1.2, p. 2. Ask: “Does 0.92 describe the part removed or the part retained?” Follow with “What multiplier represents a 12% decrease?” Answer 0.88.
:::
